name: Reviewer Interpretation Constraint Registry
purpose: Define admissible and inadmissible reviewer interpretations for RFPR packages to prevent claim inflation or semantic collapse.

inadmissible_patterns.description: Any interpretation claiming that a theorem proves a law of physics or spacetime geometry.
Any reading that silently removes local restricted assumptions (A1-A3) to imply universal validity.
Substituting ⇔R with standard logical biconditional (IFF) or equality (=).
Treating process aspects or relations as independent 'entities', 'objects', or 'substances'.
Using QM/GR unification or derivation terminology in an analog projection context.
Claiming that a local restricted proof constitutes 'complete closure' of the framework.

admissible_critiques: Mapping specific failure cases not covered by counterexample linked indices.

governance_rules.rule: Reviewer outputs containing inadmissible patterns are automatically classified as 'INVALID_INTERPRETATION'.
